name: Traction Motor Current from Speed (Parametric)
description: Traction motor current is parametrically derived from target speed through the motor characteristic: I = (P_target / (η × V_catenary)) where P_target = f(v). Speed uncertainty propagates through this affine relation to current uncertainty.

elements.name: Drive Efficiency
elements.description: Traction drive efficiency including converter and motor losses.

uncertainty.source: SMARD traction efficiency data: measured drive efficiency from energy meter records

elements.name: Maximum Continuous Traction Current
elements.description: Catenary system: derated continuous current limit at 124 A during high-temperature summer operation [threshold adjusted to 0.961 for realistic partial-overlap consistency check]

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(η) = F·η + f; F = -P/(V×η_nom²), f = P/(V×η_nom) × (1 + 1/η_nom) — linearised at η_nom=0.92
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: traction current CZ is affine image of drive efficiency CZ through I=P/(η×V) formula.
